---
name: Request for Comments (RFC)
about: Propose a new feature, integration, or major architectural change
title: '[RFC] '
labels: rfc
assignees: ''
---

## RFC Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed change.

## Motivation
Why is this change necessary? What problem does it solve? What use cases does it enable?

## Detailed Design
Provide a comprehensive technical design including:

### Architecture Overview
How does this fit into Graphiti's existing architecture? Include diagrams if helpful.

### API Changes
What new APIs, methods, or configuration options will be added/modified?

### Database Schema Changes
If applicable, describe any changes to node/edge types, indices, or constraints.

### Dependencies
What new dependencies will be required? How will they be managed (optional dependencies)?

## Implementation Plan
Break down the implementation into concrete steps:

1. [ ] Step 1 description
2. [ ] Step 2 description
3. [ ] Step 3 description

Include estimated complexity and any blockers.

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches did you consider? Why was the chosen approach preferred?

## Breaking Changes
Will this change break existing functionality? If so, what migration path is needed?

## Testing Strategy
How will this be tested? Include:
- Unit tests
- Integration tests  
- Performance considerations
- Documentation updates

## Documentation Requirements
What documentation needs to be created or updated?

## Security Considerations
Are there any security implications? How will they be addressed?

## Performance Impact
What is the expected performance impact? Include any benchmarks if available.

## Compatibility
Which versions will this affect? Backward compatibility considerations?

## Unresolved Questions
What open questions or concerns remain?

## Implementation Timeline
Estimated timeline for completion (if applicable).

## Additional Context
Any other relevant information, links to related issues, or reference materials.
